hint.document_quarantined: Nothing was deleted — the file is at {path}. Update hestia if it came from a newer version, or delete it once you have what you need from it.
hint.export_files_embedded: Nothing to do unless you mean to publish the pack — reinstall those files from a source first if you do.
hint.import_files_untracked: Reinstall them from a source to make them updatable.
hint.modpack_files_excluded: They would break a server. Add one under Always install in Settings to install it anyway, or turn the correction off to trust the pack.
hint.modpack_overrides_kept: Delete a file under the game directory to take the pack's version of it at the next update.
hint.properties_schema_missing: Any key is accepted until it can be derived again, so check spelling yourself. Updating the server re-derives it.
hint.server_list_in_use: Close the game and make the change again, or add the server from the in-game multiplayer screen instead.
hint.sync_entries_replaced: The discarded copies are gone — export an instance before sharing it again if it held anything you still want.
hint.sync_target_duplicated: Sharing '{target}' again keeps the shared copy, not this one.
hint.sync_target_not_shared: Rename or delete the clashing files in the instance’s folder, then launch again to share it.
hint.sync_target_skipped: Check the folder's permissions, then launch again.

kind.document_quarantined: {document} could not be read and was set aside: {detail}
kind.export_files_embedded: {count} file(s) had no download to reference and were embedded in the archive.
kind.import_files_untracked: {count} file(s) came from the archive itself, so they cannot be updated.
kind.modpack_files_excluded: {count} client-only mod(s) the pack called server-compatible were not installed.
kind.modpack_overrides_kept: {count} file(s) you had edited were kept instead of the modpack's.
kind.properties_schema_missing: '{name}' has no property schema, so its server.properties keys cannot be checked.
kind.server_list_in_use: “{instance}” has {sessions} session(s) open, so the running game will overwrite this change to the multiplayer list when it exits.
kind.sync_entries_replaced: The shared copies of {entries} replaced this instance's under '{target}'
kind.sync_target_duplicated: '{target}' was copied out of the shared store and is now this instance's alone
kind.sync_target_not_shared: '{target}' is not shared with your other instances: {reason}.

token.collides: files of the same name are already shared
token.foreign_link: the folder is a link you made
